bundle: Focused NUC evidence for the causal table/log bridge components.
packaging_notes: Every collected attempt source was checked against its sidecar and receipt hash.
Successful superseded attempts are classified explicitly.
Both .source.sha256 and .sha256 sidecars are preserved where emitted by the wrapper/runner.
Final sources match successful final receipts.
Final objects are retained only in the deterministic archive.
C1PartialCandidates c1partial-a is a zero-byte pre-snapshot staging artifact with no receipt and is not counted as a compile attempt.
MerkleLeafLookupExt leaf-lookup-ext-c and MerkleLogExt b are retained as superseded green attempts; final sources use later reviewed suffixes.
scope_note: Records deterministic plumbing from consistent logged reads through table/log recovery and first-read stability. This bundle does not prove an efficient list decoder, numerical security, or Rust/source closure.
